say:4:1410508003:1.male: Do you know this person? Why did you save him?
say:4:1410508003:1.female: Do you know this person? Why did you save him?

say:6:1410508005:1.text: Aha, looks like you two know each other. That saves me the trouble of introductions! I've taken this boy as a hostage!

choice_prompt:7:1410508005.text: Aha, looks like you two know each other. That saves me the trouble of introductions! I've taken this boy as a hostage!
choice_prompt:7:1410508005.source_cn: 啊？你们认识啊？省得我互相介绍了！以防万一，我抓了这孩子做人质！

say:8:1410508006:1.text: Well... Things got hectic, and I didn't have time to think it over.
say:8:1410508006:1.source_cn: 唉……算是一步险棋。刚才情况紧急，我也没时间多想了。
say:8:1410508006:1.male: Well... Things got hectic, and I didn't have time to think it over.
say:8:1410508006:1.female: Well... Things got hectic, and I didn't have time to think it over.

say:9:1410508009:1.text: If you want to kill me, go ahead!
say:9:1410508009:1.source_cn: 我不会向你们屈服的！你们要杀就杀！

say:14:1410508013:0.text: I can hang on a bit longer...

say:15:1410508014:1.text: Still breathing? That's a relief! Looks like those muscles aren't just for show!
say:15:1410508014:1.source_cn: 没死？太好了！你这大体格真不是白练的！

say:18:1410508015:0.text: Alright, if you can move, get your legs moving! We need to get out of here fast; they'll be on us soon!
say:18:1410508015:0.source_cn: 行，只要能动就赶紧倒腾你的腿！我们必须马上离开这里，那...

say:19:1410508016:1.text: No, I won't let you escape!
say:19:1410508016:1.source_cn: 不能走！我不能放你们离开！

say:20:1410508017:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... So Merlin isn't your real name, huh? You lied to me and Indris! I hate you!

say:20:1410508017:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... So Merlin isn't your real name, huh? You lied to me and Indris! I hate you!

choice_prompt:21:1410508017.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>……这才是你的名字？你根本不叫梅林！你骗了我和因度厄，早晚会自食恶果！
choice_prompt:21:1410508017.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... So Merlin isn't your real name, huh? You lied to me and Indris! I hate you!
choice_prompt:21:1410508017.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... So Merlin isn't your real name, huh? You lied to me and Indris! I hate you!

say:22:1410508018:0.text: I won't let you get away with this! If you surrender now, Her Majesty might show mercy and reduce your punishment!
say:22:1410508018:0.source_cn: 我不会放过你们！如果你们早点认罪伏法，女王陛下或许还愿...

say:23:1410508019:1.text: Hah, big talk for someone with little strength. You really think you can stop us?
say:23:1410508019:1.source_cn: 哟呵，口气不小，凭你这小胳膊也想拦住我们？

say:24:1410508020:1.text: As a priest of Sal'thorin, I'll make you regret this!
say:24:1410508020:1.source_cn: 身为萨洛克兰的祭司，我一定会——

say:25:1410508021:1.text: Shush! I'm already sick of hearing about Sal'thorin! Don't make me go full force on you!
say:25:1410508021:1.source_cn: 醒醒吧臭小子！听见萨洛克兰这破名字就烦！我不想对你动粗...

say:26:1410508022:1.text: Just be a good hostage. Once we're out of this hellhole, I'll make sure you get back in one piece!
say:26:1410508022:1.source_cn: 你乖乖做个人质，等我们离开这个鬼地方，我肯定保你安全！

say:27:1410508023:1.source_cn: 放、放了我，我不会屈服的啊啊啊——

choice:21:0:1.source_cn: 我确实也被称为梅林，不算骗你

say:29:1410508007:1.text: Uh, gut feeling? He seems like a tough character.
say:29:1410508007:1.source_cn: 呃，直觉？他看着是个厉害人物。
say:29:1410508007:1.male: Uh, gut feeling? He seems like a tough character.
say:29:1410508007:1.female: Uh, gut feeling? He seems like a tough character.

say:30:1410508008:1.text: Hmph, I'll give you credit for your sharp eye... But don't think a little praise will make me drop my guard!
